title: Sizing a Builder Extended Rate Lock Extension
content:
**Clause.** The days to cover are the calendar days from the current lock expiration date on the Builder Extended Rate Lock to the purchase agreement's scheduled closing date. The extension days are the days to cover rounded up to whole increments of the term's increment days. The increments written never exceed the term's maximum increments less the extensions already used, and the extension days never exceed the term's maximum total extension days less the extension days already used.

## Quantities

| Quantity | Definition | Record |
|---|---|---|
| Days to cover | calendar days from the current lock expiration date to the scheduled closing date | lock record; purchase agreement record |
| Increments needed | the days to cover divided by the term's increment days, any part of an increment counted as a whole increment; none where the days to cover are zero or fewer | product's extension figures |
| Increments written | the increments needed, never more than the term's maximum increments less the extensions already used on the lock | lock record |
| Extension days | the increments written times the term's increment days, never more than the term's maximum total extension days less the extension days already used on the lock | lock record |

## Worked figures (hypothetical term with 7-day increments, a maximum of 3 increments and 21 total days)

1. Lock expiration date 1 August, scheduled closing date 12 August, no extension used: days to cover 11; increments needed 2; increments written 2; extension days 14.
2. Same dates, but the lock has already used 2 increments and 14 days: increments needed 2, but only 1 remains; extension days 7, which is also the 7 days remaining of the 21.
3. Scheduled closing date 1 August, the same day as the lock expiration date: days to cover 0; no increment is needed and the extension days are 0.

## Rounding up to increments

| Days to cover | 7-day increments needed | Days |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 7 |
| 7 | 1 | 7 |
| 8 | 2 | 14 |
| 14 | 2 | 14 |
| 15 | 3 | 21 |
